Home.aboutTitle: We are not simply selling medical equipment.
Home.aboutP1: {store} is a Lebanon-based medical equipment and healthcare supplies business with {years} years of experience in healthcare and rehabilitation.
Home.aboutP2: In that time we have supported healthcare professionals, therapists, students and individuals looking for reliable medical and rehabilitation solutions, and we keep expanding our range with reliable international manufacturers.
Home.missionText: Everyone deserves access to safe, reliable, high-quality medical equipment at reasonable prices. We support professionals in their daily work, help students get the right tools for their training, and improve comfort and independence for people who need rehabilitation products.
Home.visionText: To be Lebanon's trusted provider of medical equipment and rehabilitation supplies, through long-term relationships with reliable manufacturers and high standards of quality, safety, affordability and customer satisfaction.
Home.commitmentText: To make healthcare, rehabilitation and professional practice safer, more accessible and more effective for everyone, built on trust, transparency and product quality.
Home.howText: Simple, transparent, and a real person on the other end.

Contact.title: Talk to a real person.
Contact.intro: Questions about a product, an order, or what you need for your practice or studies? We usually reply within {replyTime}.

delivery.q: Where do you deliver, and how long does it take?
delivery.a: We deliver across Lebanon. Delivery time depends on your location, generally 3–5 days.

payment.a: Cash on delivery, or by Whish / OMT transfer before dispatch.

warranty.q: Do devices come with a warranty?
warranty.a: Warranty availability, duration and coverage vary by product. Please contact {store} before purchasing to confirm whether your item includes a warranty and to learn its terms and conditions.

returns.a: Returns may be accepted for incorrect or faulty items after review. For hygiene reasons, opened or used single-use and personal-care products cannot be returned unless faulty or supplied incorrectly.

bulk.q: Do you offer prices for clinics or bulk orders?
bulk.a: Yes. Send us your list and we prepare one combined quote.

students.q: Do you offer anything for students?
students.a: Yes, we have offers for students and for group orders. Ask us for details.
